value.rationale: The first terminal edge-cut is a natural global connectivity transition for exponentially age-biased recursive trees. At fixed bias such bottlenecks support recurrence, but the weak-bias onset is exponentially delayed and its rescaled entire process is asymptotically memoryless. The exact eta-prefactor and complete Poisson point-process law quantify a metastable graph-connectivity scale and are not routine one-point degree calculations.
